description: Update reverse DNS for a dedicated server. For an IPv6 prefix, pass ipv6Address to set the PTR of any address of the /64 (omit = primary address). The hostname must already resolve to that IP (A record for IPv4, AAAA for IPv6), otherwise the change is refused (400 hostname_not_resolving). Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

ipv6Address.description: Only with ipv6PrefixAllocationId: the address of the /64 the PTR is for (full address or `::<suffix>`). Omit for the primary address.

serviceId.description: ID of the Dedicated server: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_dedicated_servers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

name: update_dedicated_reverse_dns
title: Update Dedicated Server Reverse DNS
